ana: Quick preflight — runtime v2.4.1 is scheduled for 00:30 UTC. Need a short cross-service handshake: API, Console, Router. Can we agree on pins and rollback triggers?

derek: Proposed sequence:
1) Pin Console -> 1.8.0 (config-only).
2) Deploy API 5.0.2 as a 5% canary for 10m.
3) Deploy Runtime v2.4.1 as 10% canary for 15m.
4) Flip Router to 3.1.0-compatible header split + feature flag.
Rollback if request error-rate > 2% or p95 latency > 600ms for >5m. OK? :thinking_face:

sasha: Note: runtime change includes KV eviction tweak that relies on the router header-split flag. We should not advance to full rollout until router flag is enabled and confirmed. Block at step 3 until flag is toggled.

mora: I pushed a short release-notes draft to the docs repo: https://internal.docs/release-notes/runtime-2-4-1 (tl;dr: KV eviction fix, batching kernel fallback, backcompat shim). Will add the rollback steps and the console pin note.

derek: Also adding the deploy-bot commands below so ops can eyeball them.

deploy-bot: `/deploy api --service api --version 5.0.2 --canary 5 --window 10m`
deploy-bot: output: `canary started (jobs: 12), monitoring -> /deploy-metrics/api/5.0.2`
deploy-bot: `/deploy runtime --service runtime --version v2.4.1 --canary 10 --window 15m`

ops-bot: Quick smoke checks to run during canary: `curl -H "x-debug: true" https://staging.api.internal/health`, sample load: `hey -n 1000 -c 20 https://canary.api.internal/generate`

ana: For the router flip we need a short maintenance note for the console UI (toggle visible). @derek can you update the release notes to call out console UX degradation if header split flag is off?

derek: Will do. Also setting automated rollback policy in deploy-bot: if errors > 2% for 5m -> rollback to previous pinned versions and unpin router flag. Manual rollback path: `/deploy rollback --target runtime --to previous` (adds a runbook link).

sasha: I'll be on watch during the window and will confirm the router flag toggle. If anything looks off, I will immediately set the router to pass-through and pin API back to 5.0.1.

mora: Release notes updated with rollback commands + customer-facing blurb. Leaving a note about telemetry regression alert (eval set: prompt-smoke-42).

derek: OK locking schedule: quiet window 00:30-01:15 UTC. Pin console at 00:10, start API canary 00:30, runtime canary 00:45, router flip 01:05 (if green).

ana: 👍 thanks all. I'll post the release note link in #announcements and attach the runbook.

ops-bot: Canary metrics snapshot at 00:56 -> api error-rate 0.12%, runtime p95 420ms, kv-hit-rate 98%. No rollbacks triggered.

sasha: Confirm router flag toggled at 01:06 UTC, smoke tests passing. Proceeding to full ramp now. :rocket:
